title: Liability Terms for Garments Damaged or Lost at Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
**Liability.** When a garment is damaged or lost while in a Marlowe & Finch Alterations shop, Marlowe & Finch compensates the customer.

**Reporting window.** The damage is reported within the damage window after the pickup date. The window counts calendar days starting the day after the pickup date as day 1, and a report on the last day of the class's damage-report days is in time; a lost garment is reported any time after its promised date. The pickup date and promised date are those recorded on the ticket concerned.

**Amount.** Compensation is the net amount paid for the garment on its Marlowe & Finch purchase record (or the customer's documented purchase price for other garments), at most the class's damage liability cap.

**Settlement.** Compensation is settled once per ticket as a merchandise credit card, and every charge on the ticket is waived.

**Exclusion.** Damage from fabric defects disclosed and accepted at drop-off is not compensated.

## Reporting window, both sides (hypothetical 7-day window)

| Report made | Day count after pickup | In time |
|---|---|---|
| The 7th day after pickup | day 7 | yes (last day) |
| The 8th day after pickup | day 8 | no |
| Lost garment, any day after its promised date | not counted | yes |

## Amount, hypothetical figures

| Net amount paid on the purchase record | Class cap | Compensation |
|---|---|---|
| 180.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 180.00 USD |
| 640.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 500.00 USD |

In both rows the compensation is settled as one merchandise credit card for the ticket, and every charge on the ticket is waived.
